text: Izzy Park: quick usability note from a desk test: the per-row contextual actions in the embeddings view are out of visual order vs DOM. keyboard users land on the download button before they land on the more prominent Rerank action. Marcus Lee: can you paste the DOM? sounds like a simple reorder. Izzy Park: snippet (simplified): ``` \n \n Prompt preview...\n 0.87\n \n \n \n \n \n ``` Sophie Duarte: UX note: visually Rerank is centered and more prominent; export was injected earlier. for keyboard and SR users the sequence matters. A11y QA: screen readers follow DOM order. best fix: match DOM to visual order. add `role="toolbar"` on the actions container and descriptive `aria-label` values, e.g. `aria-label="Download vector (CSV)"`. Marcus Lee: agree. also propose we make export aria-label include scope: "Download selected vectors (CSV)" when multiple selected, and "Download this vector (CSV)" when single. small JS change. Izzy Park: microcopy: prefer consistent wording: use "Download" in row actions and "Export" only for bulk export in the top toolbar, or vice versa. which feels clearer? Sophie Duarte: let's standardize on "Download" everywhere in the vectors table and keep "Export" for backend/CLI. users seem to get "Download" meaning a file. A11y QA: keyboard flow: when opening an inline rerank preview the initial focus should land on the modal heading with `tabindex=0` then next tab to primary action (Rerank). don't land on the close X. add `aria-describedby` on heading referencing a short summary: "Previewing 3 neighbors; original rank: 7". Marcus Lee: rerank modal UI ask: include a small before/after row number and announce changes via `aria-live="polite"` when user toggles candidate order: "Preview applied: item moved from 7 to 3". debounce updates so SRs not flooded. Izzy Park: keyboard shortcut idea: scoped shortcut `D` to download selected rows when vectors table has focus. show hint in compact toolbar: "Download (D)". avoid global binding. Sophie Duarte: mobile: no hover, so per-row actions must live in kebab for narrow view. on mobile the kebab menu should show explicit labels and a Download CTA. A11y QA: testing checklist I'm adding: NVDA, VoiceOver macOS, VoiceOver iOS, TalkBack. Test cases: DOM order -> SR reading order, aria-live announcements for selection counts, focus trap in rerank modal, shortcut `D` scoped behavior, and CSV naming announced in toast. Izzy Park: CSV header suggestion for clarity: `id, display_name, source, original_index, current_index, relevance_score, prompt_preview, vector_norm, created_at`. filename: `vectors--selected-.csv`. Marcus Lee: backend notes: include `original_index` and `current_index` and make `created_at` ISO8601 UTC. add API param `include_indices=true`. also emit companion metadata.json when user checks "Include metadata". Sophie Duarte: copy tweak: change tooltip on Rerank to "Rerank selected vectors — preview changes" and keep the visible label short as "Rerank". For Download tooltip: "Download selected vectors (CSV)". A11y QA: minor SR behavior: when export completes, have a polite live region say "Download ready: vectors--selected-20260301.csv". ensure the toast is focusable but doesn't auto-steal focus. DesignBot: Created issue #5491: "Embeddings: row contextual actions DOM order, rerank modal a11y, download semantics, CSV headers" and assigned to Marcus Lee. :white_check_mark: Sophie Duarte: I'll upload a compact mock with reordered DOM and a focused-label microinteraction by EOD. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
